verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Gusto's Embedded Payroll API, webhooks, SDKs, and MCP integrations, but contains no mention of a bulk data-export feature, open-format (CSV/JSON) export of all payroll/HR records, or an account-closure/data-portability workflow for end users. Community commentary even flags 'platform lock-in for new features' (gusto-comm-4), suggesting the opposite of easy portability, but this doesn't rise to a documented contradiction of a claimed export feature—there's simply no claim to dispute.
